research.notes: WebSearch budget was exhausted, so only the agency's own site was used (no registry lookup). No street address was shown on the cited pages, so address and headquarters are null.

profile.summary: A California state agency that protects and improves working conditions for the state's wage earners. It enforces laws on wages, hours and workplace safety, oversees workers' compensation, and manages apprenticeship training programs. It is housed within the Labor and Workforce Development Agency.
